sources.snippet: RL in Production Workshop · Assignment Goal: Implement the Q-learning algorithm from scratch (no neural networks) and train an agent to solve the classic Taxi dispatch problem. By the end you will have a working agent, learning curves, and a set of small experiments that build real intuition for the Bellman update. This is the foundation for Project 2.
